[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
James Glasgow was born on 25 December 1777 in Kelso, Roxburghshire, Scotland. The saved Kelso OPR derivative records this as a birth date, with no baptism date exposed, and names David Glasgow and Janet Hood as his parents. The existing father [[Glasgow-1218|David Glasgow]] remains assessed at 94% (proved); [[Hood-6028|Janet (Hood) Glasgow]] is the current compatible mother-profile candidate, still unassessed. The prior draft’s [[Glasgow-1219|Janet Glasgow]] link is retained here as superseded profile-link history, not a second mother.<ref>Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950. MyHeritage.com [online database], accessed 2025. https://www.myheritage.com/research/record-30226-3025161/james-glasgow-in-scotland-births-baptisms.</ref><ref name="JamesBirth1777">Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F5056630&tab=this SCOT/OPR/BAP/5056630], Kelso OPR 793/3 item 1 p.103; derivative transcript, original register uninspected.</ref> He passed away in 1853.

=== Possible James Glasgow and father David, Kelso militia list, 1798 ===
James Glasgow, son to David Glasgow, is named in the Kelso parish militia ballot list accompanying a Jedburgh notice dated 29 September 1798.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/395735887/ The Caledonian Mercury, 1798-10-04, p.1].</ref>

The entry expressly identifies the listed James as David’s son; it does not say "junior". David is described with a weaving descriptor whose exact reading remains qualified. Selection in a militia ballot does not prove completed service or identify James’s mother.

This may concern [[Glasgow-1222]]. For James, Exact recorded 25 December 1777 Kelso birth and later Edinburgh death fit this 1798 James. No individual militia identifier proves assignment; the public father link is tree-derived only.

=== Kelso James Glasgow and Isabella Fettis household comparison, 24 October 2026 ===

Saved Findmypast derivatives name James (abbreviated Jas in the 1813 entries) Glasgow and Isabella Fettis as parents in four Kelso child entries: Charles, born 18 March 1805 (OPR 793/4 item 2 p.368); Elisabeth, indexed birth year 1807 (three companion indexes); Charles, indexed birth year 1813 (p.214); and Elizabeth, indexed birth year 1813 (p.248). The 1807 indexes repeat one entry, not three children. The 1813 Charles and Elizabeth are separate indexed entries; the source fields do not establish twins. The later same-name entries must not be equated with or split from the earlier children without the original pages and life-course evidence. Only Charles's 1805 day/month is expressly labelled a birth date; the other three groups give birth year only, and none supplies an actual baptism date.<ref name="KelsoCharles1805">Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F5059684&tab=this SCOT/OPR/BAP/5059684], OPR 793/4 item 2 p.368; saved derivative transcript, original uninspected.</ref><ref name="KelsoElisabeth1807">Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929, companion indexes [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_686711246&tab=this R_686711246], [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_690795906&tab=this R_690795906] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_690796739&tab=this R_690796739]; saved derivatives, original uninspected.</ref><ref name="KelsoCharles1813">Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F5058867&tab=this SCOT/OPR/BAP/5058867], OPR 793/4 item 2 p.214; saved derivative, original uninspected.</ref><ref name="KelsoElizabeth1813">Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F5059061&tab=this SCOT/OPR/BAP/5059061], OPR 793/4 item 2 p.248; saved derivative, original uninspected.</ref>

[[Glasgow-1222]] is a compatible comparison for the recorded adult James because he was born at Kelso in 1777, but no marriage, occupation, address or later child record links him to Isabella Fettis or any of these four entries. Isabella has no identified current profile here. These child records do not establish a spouse or parent-profile attachment, strengthen James's 94% upstream father assessment, or prove his later Edinburgh identity. Inspect the original pages and seek a James–Isabella marriage or residence bridge. No new person is proposed from a missing bridge or same-name dates.
